info.title: kjbox singer API
info.description: App-facing singer API served by a kjbox (KJ controller) at a Nomad Karaoke night. Hand-maintained; kjbox's integration tests validate every v1 response against this file (kj-controller/tests/integration/v1_contract.py). Additive changes only within v1; every response carries api_version "1.N". Every call needs the bearer gen session token and the night's event code t (query string or JSON body). Errors are {error, message?, retry_after?} with the HTTP status; error codes are the closed ErrorCode enum. Every read and write is scoped to the current night: send the night_id you last saw and a 409 night_changed (carrying the new night_id) tells you the host started a new night.

get.summary: Tonight's venue info, feature flags and whether the singer still needs a name
get.description: Returns 200 {open: false} (not 403) when requests are closed, the event code is wrong or no night has started, so the app can show the closed state with the host's message.

post.summary: Set the singer's name for tonight
post.description: Sets the account's singer name (device alias, origin self). The app device is linked to the gen account for tonight on any v1 call.

Same rules as the web's /sing/submit. The singer name is the account's name for tonight (POST /join; 400 needs_name before that) or friend_name for a song for a friend; the request belongs to the app device. Idempotent on client_request_id: a retry returns the first response; while the first attempt is still running a retry gets 409 busy_retry (retry_after 2); a failed attempt can be retried with the same id. A make-it (source_type make, source_meta {search_session_id, selection_index} from POST /make/search or {youtube_url}) creates the gen job on the app user's own gen account first, then goes straight into the rotation as Being Made (auto_approved true). Make-it errors: make_disabled (off, Simple Mode, or tonight's per-device make-it limit), youtube_blocked, gen_rejected, 409 conflict with message search_expired (search again), 401 unauthenticated when gen refuses the session. A make-it's first attempt may take several minutes (gen's create-job), and retries get busy_retry until it finishes.

200.description: Request created (or the stored response for this client_request_id)

post.summary: Cancel one of the account's songs
post.description: Pending: cancelled. Approved: the rotation entry is marked Cancelled for the host. Sung (Done/Left): 409 already_sung. On stage: 409 on_stage. Cancelling an already cancelled request returns it again. The request must belong to one of the account's devices tonight (403 not_owner).

post.summary: Change the song of one of the account's requests
post.description: Keeps the queue slot: a pending request is updated in place; an approved one gets a new request that supersedes it (auto-approved when the host has auto-approve on, taking over the old slot). A replay (same client_request_id on the same request) returns the new (superseding) request; `request.id` may differ from the path id. Can't change into a make-it (400 make_disabled), once sung (409 already_sung) or while on stage (409 on_stage).
Swaps only within the singer's own slots. Every item must be the account's request or an entry naming the singer (403 not_owner otherwise). Applies at once when the host has auto-approve on.

put.description: Sets or clears the consent for one of the account's own songs (not a friend's: 400 invalid). Unknown consent means no.

get.summary: Your songs, your next turn and what you've sung tonight
get.description: Built server-side from every request the account's devices (the app plus web pages linked tonight) made tonight, plus queued entries naming the singer that the host or a duet partner added. Never takes request ids from the client. Poll every 15 s while visible.

put.summary: Change name, phone or photo consent
put.description: Applies to every song the account owns tonight except friend songs; a rename never rewrites sung (Done) songs. Renaming to a different first name while own songs are queued needs confirm_rename: true (else 409 conflict, reason rename_guard). Fields apply in order (name, then phone, then photo consent) with no rollback across them: if a later one fails, the earlier ones stay applied. A name the host set or merged can't be changed here (409 conflict, reason host_named).

get.summary: Karaoke search: one entry per song with every version
get.description: Delegates to the web search. A query under 3 characters is 400 invalid.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The typed query (3+ characters for search)

parameters.name: sid
parameters.description: Client search id, groups the search log

get.summary: Which real song the text means

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The typed query (3+ characters for search)

parameters.name: sid
parameters.description: Client search id, groups the search log

get.summary: Auto-correct a search that found nothing
get.description: Rate limited per device (20 per 5 minutes by default).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The typed query (3+ characters for search)

parameters.name: sid
parameters.description: Client search id, groups the search log

get.summary: Tonight's singer names for duet partners
Now on stage and up next
The active rotation with wait estimates
get.description: ETag is "<rotation_rev>". Authentication still applies to a 304. The wait estimates (expected_s, range_*) are relative to the response that carried them: a 304 keeps the earlier ones, so the app counts down locally from when it received them.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: The last ETag; equal (quotes ignored) gives 304 with no body

304.description: Unchanged since the If-None-Match revision; empty body, ETag header still sent

post.summary: Resolve a song version to a playable preview
post.description: Rate limited per network (12 per minute by default, 429 with retry_after). 404 not_found when an entry has nothing to preview yet. mode unavailable (200) when this version can't be previewed.

post.summary: Tell the host a tip was sent
post.description: The singer name is the device's name (400 needs_name with none). client_request_id (UUID) is required and makes the claim idempotent. Rate limited (5 per 10 minutes, 429). 400 invalid with message tips_disabled when the host turned tips off.

get.description: Top songs only; the web's per-name history lookup is not exposed, and any name parameter is ignored.

post.summary: Check the artist and title (gen's match judge)
post.description: Runs as the app user's own gen account (the bearer is forwarded to gen for this call and never stored), so jobs land in that account. 400 make_disabled when make-it is off tonight, in Simple Mode, or the box has no gen partner set-up (GET /night features.make is false then). Fails open: a gen failure returns kind none, except a rejected session (401 unauthenticated).

401.description: Missing or rejected gen session token, including gen refusing it during this make-it call (error unauthenticated). Does not by itself mean the app should sign out: check the session with gen first.

post.summary: Search for audio to make the song from
post.description: Runs as the app user's own gen account (the bearer is forwarded to gen for this call and never stored), so jobs land in that account. 400 make_disabled when make-it is off tonight, in Simple Mode, or the box has no gen partner set-up (GET /night features.make is false then). First tops up a free show credit when the account's balance is empty (one per song per night; the submit uses the same key, so a song costs the singer nothing and gen grants at most one credit for it). 400 make_disabled also when this account has searched for too many different songs tonight. 400 youtube_blocked when gen's YouTube access is being bot-checked, gen_rejected when gen refuses (e.g. no credits).

401.description: Missing or rejected gen session token, including gen refusing it during this make-it call (error unauthenticated). Does not by itself mean the app should sign out: check the session with gen first.

post.summary: Check a link to make the song from (gen's URL fallback)
post.description: Runs as the app user's own gen account (the bearer is forwarded to gen for this call and never stored), so jobs land in that account. 400 make_disabled when make-it is off tonight, in Simple Mode, or the box has no gen partner set-up (GET /night features.make is false then).

401.description: Missing or rejected gen session token, including gen refusing it during this make-it call (error unauthenticated). Does not by itself mean the app should sign out: check the session with gen first.

post.description: Links the make-it job's quick (scrolling-lyrics draft) version to the singer's rotation entry so it can be sung now; the full version still replaces it if it lands before their turn. The request must belong to one of the account's devices tonight (403 not_owner). 404 not_found (message quick_not_ready) until the quick version is ready, or when the request is not a make-it; 409 conflict (message already_ready) when the entry already has its video; 400 make_disabled when the host turned quick versions off.

401.description: Missing or rejected gen session token, including gen refusing it during this make-it call (error unauthenticated). Does not by itself mean the app should sign out: check the session with gen first.

post.summary: Register this device's Expo push token
post.description: Idempotent per token. Tonight's updates (approved, up in 2, up next, now singing, sung) go to the token; Expo reports a dead token and kjbox then stops sending to it.

genSession.description: The singer's Nomad Karaoke (gen) session token. kjbox verifies it with gen's GET /api/users/me.

EventCode.name: t
EventCode.description: The night's event code. Required on every call, here or as JSON body field t.

NightId.name: night_id
NightId.description: The night_id the app last saw (also accepted as JSON body field night_id). A mismatch returns 409 night_changed.

Unauthenticated.description: Missing or rejected gen session token (error unauthenticated). Does not by itself mean the app should sign out.

NotOpen.description: Requests are closed, the event code is wrong, or no night has started (error not_open)

NightChanged.description: The host started a new night (error night_changed); night_id is the new one

GenUnavailable.description: kjbox couldn't verify the token with gen (error gen_unavailable); retry after retry_after seconds

RateLimited.description: Too many wrong event codes or sign-in checks from this network (error rate_limited); retry after retry_after seconds (also the Retry-After header)

Default.description: Any other error: not_found (unknown v1 path, 404), invalid (wrong method, 405), internal (500)

Forbidden.description: not_open (requests closed, wrong event code or no night) or not_owner (the request isn't one of this account's devices' tonight)

NotFound.description: not_found: no such request tonight under this event code (a previous night's request looks the same)

RequestConflict.description: night_changed (with night_id, see NightChangedError), already_sung, on_stage, busy_retry (retry after retry_after seconds), already_generating, or conflict

RequestRateLimited.description: rate_limited: this account's device (8 per 5 min by default) or this network is over the singer mutation budget, or too many wrong event codes / sign-in checks; retry after retry_after seconds (also the Retry-After header)

RequestInvalid.description: invalid (message says why), needs_name (POST /join first), kj_pick_too_large (over 1000 versions), make_disabled, youtube_blocked or gen_rejected

RenameGuard.description: night_changed (with night_id, see NightChangedError) or conflict with reason rename_guard (see RenameGuardError)

MakeRateLimited.description: rate_limited: this account's make-it budget (40 calls per 10 minutes per device, 400 per network) is used up, or gen is limiting it; retry after retry_after seconds (also the Retry-After header)

message.description: English detail for logs; the app shows its own translated copy per error code

night_id.description: Only on night_changed (see NightChangedError): the current night's id

reason.description: Only on PUT /me's 409 conflict (see RenameGuardError): why it was refused

from.description: Only with reason rename_guard or host_named: the current name

to.description: Only with reason rename_guard or host_named: the name asked for

reason.description: closed: the host has requests switched off; bad_code: the event code doesn't match tonight's; no_night: the box has no current night

footer_message.description: The host's message; only when reason is closed

notices.description: Switched-on venue notices, in order: pre-built keys (chargers, lyricsScreen, duets, moreSongs, tipsHelp, wifi, water, photos; the app owns their copy) or host-written c-<id> keys (see notice_defs)

notice_defs.description: Icon/text for host-written notices and host edits to pre-built ones (switched-on keys only)

rev.description: Rotation revision; changes whenever the queue changes

needs_name.description: True until the singer has a name (POST /join)

suggested_name.description: Present when needs_name: a prefill from the gen account, or null for no prefill

Social.description: The host's social links (https URLs); only set ones are present

Contact.description: Ways to reach the host; only set ones are present

make.description: Make-it (generate a missing song) is offered tonight

simple_mode.description: Only on-the-box/cloud-mirror/KaraokeNerds sources may be requested

quick_version.description: Make-it jobs also get a quick scrolling-lyrics draft

t.description: Event code (or the t query parameter)

NightChangedError.description: 409 night_changed: the host started a new night; drop the old night's state and use night_id

SongRequest.description: A singer request as the app sees it (the web's public request view, never the edit_token).

supersedes_request_id.description: On a song change: the request this one replaces

for_friend.description: Requested by this account for someone else (singer_name is the friend)

auto_approved.description: True when it went straight into the rotation without the host

client_request_id.description: Idempotency key (24 h): a retry with the same id returns the first response and never makes a second request

source_ref.description: Required for local, divebar, kn and youtube

source_meta.description: kj_pick: {versions: [...]} (send them all; the box keeps the best 50 and refuses only over 1000); make: the chosen audio

for_friend.description: A song for someone else: singer_name is friend_name, not the account's name; photo consent is ignored

client_request_id.description: Idempotency key: a retry with the same id returns the first response (even though the original request is now superseded) and never makes a second change

source_ref.description: Required for local, divebar, kn and youtube

source_meta.description: kj_pick: {versions: [...]} (send them all; the box keeps the best 50 and refuses only over 1000); make: the chosen audio

entry_id.description: A queued rotation entry naming this singer (host-added, or a partner's duet)

items.description: The singer's queued songs in the new order

consent.description: null clears the per-song choice (the night-wide one applies)

RenameGuardError.description: 409 conflict from PUT /me. reason rename_guard: the first name changes while the singer has their own songs queued; ask "Rename yourself to {to}?" (or "{to} is a friend: request a song for them") and resend with confirm_rename: true. reason host_named: the host set or merged this singer's name, so only the host can change it (confirm_rename doesn't help); tell the singer to ask the host.

SongItemRequest.description: The request behind a Your-songs row: the account's own request (SongRequest), or, for a host- or partner-added entry, a synthetic view with id null, source_type 'rotation' and the entry's one 'Title - Artist' string in song_title.

id.description: null for host- or partner-added entries (use the Song's entry_id)

supersedes_request_id.description: On a song change: the request this one replaces

for_friend.description: Requested by this account for someone else (singer_name is the friend)

Estimate.description: Wait estimate for a queued song (kjbox wait_estimate.compute_estimate)

Song.description: One row of Your songs: the web /my-requests item plus owner (and history_id once sung).

owner.description: me: the account's own request; friend: requested by the account for someone else; host: the host typed it in; partner: another singer's request naming this singer (a duet; added_by says who); web: the singer's own request from a web page not linked to the account yet (see unlinked_identity_entries). host, partner and web rows can only be reordered (by entry_id).

performed.description: Sung (Done) or the singer left: listed in sung_tonight

previewable.description: The entry's file is on the box (▶ Preview)

removed.description: The host took it off the list: show honest copy and Dismiss

make.description: Make-it phase, null once the video is ready

gen_job_id.description: Make-it songs of owner me or friend only: the karaoke-gen job id of the account's own job (the app opens its native review with it); null until gen has created the job. Absent on every other song.

entry_id.description: Host- and partner-added rows: the rotation entry

history_id.description: Only on performed songs that aren't a friend's: "kj_" + sha256(box_id:entry_id:email)[:24], the id decide's karaoke log uses for this performance. null on a host-, partner- or web-added song matched to the singer by name when someone else may have that name tonight (another device submitted under it or is aliased to it): it's listed, but not recorded as this singer's.

name.description: null until POST /join (or PUT /me with a name)

phone.description: Newest number on the account's own requests tonight

NextTurn.description: The singer's next queued song (own, host- or partner-added; never a friend's)

songs.description: Not yet sung, in queue order (on stage, position, approved without estimate, pending, rejected/removed)

sung_tonight.description: Sung tonight: the account's own and friend requests, plus host-, partner- and web-added entries naming the singer that were marked Done

unlinked_identity_entries.description: Live requests naming the singer from a device not linked to any account: show "Requested songs on the web page too? Open it and tap Save tonight's songs" when > 0

confirm_rename.description: The singer confirmed the rename guard

SearchSong.description: One song with every available karaoke version, exactly as the web search groups them. The per-version objects (source local|kn|..., with the matching local/kn payload) are the web's own shape and are passed through; the app reads source, artist, title, version_count and versions[].

karaoke_nerds_timeout.description: Present (true) when the community-catalogue lookup timed out

unavailable.description: With status none: the on-box song index isn't available

IdentifyResult.description: Which real song the typed text means (separate from whether a karaoke version exists).

ResolveResult.description: Auto-correct for a search that found nothing. Only the keys that apply are present: corrected+kind+typed+songs+split, or alternatives, or split alone, or none of them.

sid.description: The search id the events belong to

action.description: A search_log choice action (unknown ones are 400 invalid)

SingersResult.description: Tonight's singer names, for duet partner chips

NowResult.description: Cancelled, Done and Left entries are excluded

rev.description: The rotation revision; also the ETag (quoted)

RotationResult.description: Active rotation (Cancelled, Done and Left excluded) with wait estimates

PreviewRequest.description: The web's preview descriptor: source local|divebar|youtube with that source's fields as the search result gave them, or source entry|entry_quick with entry_id.

reason.description: With mode unavailable: why (English, for logs)

stream_url.description: native_video / native_audio: absolute URL on the request's host (supports Range)

PreviewResult.description: Returned URLs are absolute on the host the request came in on (no /sing prefix on the public host, /sing on the admin host) and carry ?t=<event code>.

client_request_id.description: Generated once per tip; a retry with the same id never creates a second tip request

TipClaimRequest.description: The name is always the device's name (needs_name when none). client_request_id makes the claim idempotent (the first response is replayed; 409 busy_retry while the first attempt is still running).

MyStatsResult.description: Tonight's crowd favourites only: never a per-person lookup

SearchVersion.description: One karaoke version of a song, the web's own shape (passed through, so further keys may appear). The fields the web reads are listed.

source.description: local (a file on the box) or kn (community/commercial catalogue row)

local.description: With source local: path, artist, title, format

kn.description: With source kn: brand_code, brand_name, is_community, youtube_url, mirror_only, divebar (mirror file info)

MakeSongRequest.description: What the singer typed (or the corrected names).

stage.description: fast (default) or full (after the audio search)

tier.description: The audio search's confidence tier, for the full stage

MakeCheckResult.description: gen's match judge verdict, passed through (further keys may appear). On a gen failure other than a rejected session the box fails open with kind none.

MakeAudioResult.description: One audio source from gen's search, gen's own shape (passed through; further keys may appear). Rank them with the app's audio-search ranking (mirrors gen's).

search_session_id.description: Send it back in the submit's source_meta with the chosen result's index

MakeUrlResult.description: gen's URL check, passed through (further keys may appear)

t.description: Event code (or the t query parameter)
